---
title: "abundance_proportions"
output: html_document
date: "2026-11-05"
---
```{bash}


TABLE="output/week3/03.2-metabarcoding-workflow/16s-table.qza"
TAXONOMY="output/project/16s-taxonomy.qza"
OUT="output/project/relative-abundance"

mkdir -p "$OUT"

# 1. Combine ASVs belonging to the same genus
qiime taxa collapse \
  --i-table "$TABLE" \
  --i-taxonomy "$TAXONOMY" \
  --p-level 6 \
  --o-collapsed-table "$OUT/genus-counts.qza"


```

```{bash}
source /opt/anaconda/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate qiime2-2026.7
cd ~/Dailey-546
TABLE="output/week3/03.2-metabarcoding-workflow/16s-table.qza"
TAXONOMY="output/project/16s-taxonomy.qza"
OUT="output/project/relative-abundance"

# 2. Convert counts to proportions within each sample
qiime feature-table relative-frequency \
  --i-table "$OUT/genus-counts.qza" \
  --o-relative-frequency-table "$OUT/genus-proportions.qza"


```

```{bash}
source /opt/anaconda/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate qiime2-2026.7
cd ~/Dailey-546
TABLE="output/week3/03.2-metabarcoding-workflow/16s-table.qza"
TAXONOMY="output/project/16s-taxonomy.qza"
OUT="output/project/relative-abundance"
# 3. Export the table
qiime tools export \
  --input-path "$OUT/genus-proportions.qza" \
  --output-path "$OUT/exported"

```

```{bash}
source /opt/anaconda/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate qiime2-2026.7
cd ~/Dailey-546
TABLE="output/week3/03.2-metabarcoding-workflow/16s-table.qza"
TAXONOMY="output/project/16s-taxonomy.qza"
OUT="output/project/relative-abundance"
# 4. Convert BIOM to a table you can open in Excel or R
biom convert \
  -i "$OUT/exported/feature-table.biom" \
  -o "$OUT/genus-proportions.tsv" \
  --to-tsv

```
